answer: Behavioral timing inlet analysis: after each epoch, correlate agents' action-timestamp distributions against a shared timing pulse sampled from verified humans. Sybil clusters created in one batch share micro-timing artifacts—identical latency profiles, correlated idle periods. The detector flags a meadow of near-duplicate timestamp fingerprints and quarantines the group. To evade, an attacker must stagger creation across many weeks and simulate organic timing jitter per identity, paying roughly one full human-equivalent setup cost per sockpuppet.
